units.function: Embedded-PostgreSQL and Express regression suite for artifact gallery projection, stars, filters, flat/grouped cursors, hierarchy aggregation, malformed relations and route tenancy.
units.dependencyDirection: Real Drizzle tables and storage stubs drive the service directly; a real company router verifies selected transport authorization cases.
units.keyDataModels: Agent- and user-authored documents, document membership/star, attachments/assets, Paperclip work products, heartbeat runs, issues/parents/projects, artifact/group projections and cursors.
units.lifecycle: Seed two companies and multiple provenance/source variants; list/star/filter/page/group artifacts; inject malformed cross-company references; assert exclusions and route denial; clean all rows.
units.testAssessment: The suite is strong on malformed foreign issue/project/run references, source-noise exclusions, attachment/work-product dedupe intent, user-specific stars, storage previews, filters, flat/grouped/selected-group cursors and parent-task grouping. Focused Vitest passed the one non-database cross-company Agent route case; all 11 embedded-PostgreSQL cases were explicitly skipped after the database failed to start. Missing coverage includes arbitrary-depth dedupe, group truncation, cycles, signed/filter-bound cursors, concurrent paging, storage concurrency/timeouts, unsafe metadata paths, private data contracts, provenance quarantine and immutable evidence.
units.designRationale: Project a practical cross-source output gallery while defending against historically malformed tenant link rows.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs similarly adversarial evidence-projection tests, but evidence must bind goals, actions, responsible humans, Agents, data authority, approvals, integrity and results—not only gallery media.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT same-company join, malformed-link, hidden-record, bounded-preview, source-deduplication, flat/grouped cursor and parent-hierarchy scenarios into EvidenceProjection integration tests. Add complete provenance/responsibility contracts, confidential data ACL, corrupted hierarchy, stable snapshots, arbitrary volume, signed cursors and Connector evidence cases.
units.responsibilityConflict: The expected model silently accepts a work product whose creator run belongs elsewhere by setting createdByAgent=null. Human authorship appears only in starred documents, and no test requires accountable human, approval, data contract or evidence digest.

units.function: Cross-source company artifact gallery over Agent-created documents, Paperclip work products, direct Agent attachments and user-starred documents, with flat/task/parent-task views.
units.dependencyDirection: A 773-line service owns PostgreSQL queries and joins, Paperclip provider heuristics, storage reads, Markdown cleanup, media classification, cursors, hierarchy traversal, route URLs and UI-oriented response DTOs. Callers provide companyId, optional raw userId and SQL issue conditions.
units.keyDataModels: Artifact source/media projection, starred document membership, work-product metadata paths, attachment asset, issue/project/Agent summaries, artifact cursor and task group.
units.lifecycle: Parse query; load company; independently fetch source branches; infer provenance/media; read text previews; deduplicate some attachment-backed work products; merge/sort/page or load ancestors/build in-memory groups; return presentation URLs.
units.testAssessment: Source and skipped database tests demonstrate careful company-bound joins, hidden/harness exclusions, 4KB preview ranges and stable timestamp/ID intent. Source also proves untested/incompletely tested defects: capped/nondeterministic dedupe, grouped pre-aggregation truncation, raw metadata paths, unbounded storage concurrency, corrupted-hierarchy ambiguity and caller-supplied identity/SQL policy.
units.designRationale: Offer one useful gallery across heterogeneous Agent outputs without creating a separate canonical artifact table, while hiding internal/system/noisy sources and preserving task context.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS requires a canonical Evidence/Result model and read projection that can prove who produced what, under which work/responsibility/data/approval contract, across every Connector and deployment profile.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT around immutable Evidence and Result records plus an EvidenceProjectionPort. Store canonical source principal/run/work/action/contract/approval/data-authority/content-digest/integrity state; use explicit visibility policy and verified Principal; represent human and Agent provenance; quarantine invalid links; return neutral IDs rather than UI routes; paginate from a complete indexed projection. ADAPT company-bound join patterns, visibility guards, byte-range previews, media adapter concept, deterministic tie-breaking and malformed-reference fixtures.
units.responsibilityConflict: Artifact membership is inferred from Agent creator fields, provider='paperclip', system-key exclusions and stars. Foreign/missing run provenance becomes null instead of invalid evidence; human creators, accountable owners, approvals, permissions/data contracts and content attestations are absent.

focused companion evidence: 1 route test passed / 11 database tests skipped; source fully reviewed
securityFindings: The service accepts caller-selected companyId, raw userId and arbitrary SQL issueConditions rather than a verified Principal and typed data-access decision.
Work-product metadata content/open/download paths are returned directly; fallback openPath accepts any string without proving an internal attachment capability, safe scheme or content provenance.
Attachment/work-product dedupe is capped by an unordered sourceFetchLimit query, so deeper backing records can be emitted twice with contradictory identities/provenance.
Grouped modes truncate each source before aggregation and expose no truncation indicator, causing incomplete counts/groups and potentially hiding evidence from responsibility review.
Up to 500 text attachments can trigger concurrent storage reads with no concurrency, deadline or cancellation budget; failures are silently erased from the projection.
Cursors are unsigned and unbound to company/query/snapshot; hierarchy cycles and invalid source provenance are silently projected instead of producing integrity warnings or quarantine states.
